name: scmjs-plugin-trigscript
description: TrigScript — TypeScript that builds into triggers; a plugin for the scmJS StarCraft map editor.
author: Jeany

scripts.build: esbuild plugin.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --outfile=dist/plugin.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build - do not edit; the source is plugin.ts." && esbuild compiler/entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=browser --outfile=dist/compiler.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build - do not edit; the source is compiler/entry.ts. The compile worker imports this when the plugin is compiled into the editor." && esbuild compiler/testingEntry.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/testing.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build - do not edit; the source is compiler/testingEntry.ts. The plugin never loads this: it is what another repository's tests import to run triggers." && dts-bundle-generator --silent --no-banner --project tsconfig.json -o dist/testing.d.ts compiler/testingEntry.ts
